scenario: A residential mortgage underwriting agent processes loan applications for two equally-qualified applicants: it extracts each applicant's income, employment, and collateral data; computes loan-to-value ratio, affordability score, and collateral risk score; and produces a final underwriting recommendation (Approve / Counter-offer / Deny) with rate pricing tier.
info_flow: financial-calculator ingests applicant income, down payment, and collateral data to produce LTV ratio, debt-to-income score, and an affordability index → afrexai-real-estate-engine evaluates the subject property's market context and outputs a collateral quality score → loan uses the combined numeric scores to structure credit narrative and issue an underwriting recommendation with pricing tier.
